purpose: Separate an exact replication of the paper's DMC environment-eligibility diagnostic from a new Symthaea model-side experiment.

paper.title: Where Individual-Effect Information Survives: A Diagnostic Ladder for World Models
paper.author: Tsuyoshi Okita
paper.scope_limit: The paper's results cover twelve deliberately formulated environments and small, low-dimensional models; transfer to large visual/robotic world models is open.

paper_dmc_formulation.individual_definition: One realization of exogenous physical-body parameters; perturbations include pole length.

mask_sweep.published_description: Five mask rates and four orderings; seventeen groups; five seeds each.
unresolved: Exact five mask-rate values and complete seventeen-group design
Exact ordered observation-column list and fixed random masking permutation
Exact mapping between the four table labels and all seventeen experimental groups

eligibility_result.measurability_C4: pass under the paper's A >= 3*phi convention
eligibility_result.convergence_C5: pass as reported by the paper
eligibility_result.note: These are paper-reported environment/measurement values for its exact formulation, not Symthaea measurements and not a trained DMC world-model score.

model_checkpoint.consequence: The paper does not report a trained-world-model latent-versus-rollout comparison for this DMC formulation. DMC is an environment-eligibility/observability diagnostic in the paper. A Symthaea model-side result on this task is a new extension, not a reproduction of a paper DMC model result.

paper_method_details_to_preserve: Individual contrasts are centred within each intervention pair before the third-rung diagnostic, separating heterogeneous individual effects from the pair's mean treatment effect.
The paper uses a random-forest estimator and five seeds for its DMC mask diagnostic.
Individuals, not the 15 pair rows, are the independent resampling unit.
C4 reports the estimation floor beside A; the three-times-floor convention is paper-specific, not a universal theorem.

task_source.initial_state: Standard upstream implementation randomizes cart/pole positions and small initial velocities; this is not the paper's individual physical-body-parameter perturbation protocol.

current_upstream_reference.status: current upstream API/source pin only; not yet proven to match the paper's simulator version, physical-parameter sampling, branch driver, or exact task configuration.

unresolved_reproduction_inputs: Exact DMC and MuJoCo versions used for the paper, including model XML and physical constants.
Names, distributions, ranges, correlations and sampling seeds for each perturbed physical-body parameter.
The six action-sequence vectors, durations, control scaling, branch point semantics and terminal horizon.
Exact observation block construction, feature ordering, mask-rate values and fixed random masking permutation.
The exact individual/cohort seeds, split and five-seed mapping.
Exact simulator snapshot/restore procedure and proof of factual-prefix equality for all 6 branches.
Exact outcome component and aggregation over the 12-block horizon.
Exact random-forest settings, cross-fitting folds, residual/floor calculation, and C5 sample-size convergence rule.
A public link to the paper's promised simulation scripts, generated data and figure/table reproduction code.

preconditions: Recover and hash the complete paper task/intervention/estimator configuration before labelling any run a replication.
Re-run C1 action efficacy, C2 same-individual branchability, C3 individual dependence, C4 estimation-floor/readability and C5 sample-size convergence on the pinned implementation.
Require factual-prefix equality across sibling interventions, same hidden individual parameters and shared exogenous forcing; allow post-action endogenous trajectories to diverge.
Validate snapshot/restore and stochastic source-to-draw evidence using the owning Symtropy verifier; hash fields alone are not authentication.
Keep the 15 contrasts from one individual together in all splits and resamples.
Freeze train/validation/test individual IDs, intervention pairs, masks, seeds and evaluator profile before training.
paper_replication_success: Exact parameterization and all unresolved inputs recovered and source-pinned.
C1-C5 reproduced with an estimation floor and individual-cluster uncertainty.
Table 7 values and seed spread reproduced within a preregistered tolerance on the identical formulation.
No claim of a DMC model-side comparison, since the paper contains no DMC trained checkpoint.
symthaea_extension_success_targets_not_r: HDC+CfC/LTC rollout predicts centred individual contrasts better than zero-effect, branch-point-only and history-only simple baselines on held-out individuals.
HDC+CfC/LTC is compared against HDC-only, CfC/LTC-only, a matched GRU/RSSM baseline where faithfully implemented, and reconstruction-only versus reconstruction-plus-contrast training.
The frozen-latent readout and imagined rollout are reported separately; report A_lat, A_pred and the loss at each transition.
Aspirational rollout-retention target: A_pred/A_lat >= 0.90 where A_lat is itself estimable above the declared floor; this is a prospective target requiring preregistration, not a paper result.

Report individual-effect MAE relative to the zero-effect predictor, sign accuracy, within-pair-centred correlation, calibration slope/intercept, worst-bin bias, action ranking, and decision regret separately.
Decision sufficiency remains owned by Symthaea #13239/#13152; statistical cluster inference remains owned by #8578.
Any claimed resource advantage uses measured bytes, compute, latency and energy on the actual candidate path.

explicit_non_claims: No paper source code or generated data has yet been recovered from a linked public repository.
The current dm_control 1.0.52 pin is not asserted to be the paper's DMC version.
A=0.396 and phi=0.093 are not Symthaea results.
No DMC training run, model benchmark, HDC/CfC advantage, SOTA improvement, simulator validation, HIL restoration or physical safety result is claimed.

findings.finding: Per-step BPTT uses a single evolved-state target; contrastive_update is positive/negative hypervector attraction/repulsion, not a paired action-trajectory effect loss.
Teacher-forced next-token cross-entropy training, not a physical world-transition trainer.
Contrastive loss separates thought/token intents; not an individual treatment-effect contrast.
Separate network-level temporal forward interface; compatibility with the older per-neuron BPTT API has not been established.
Contains an ignored test_training_changes_output test marked as a known training issue; not evidence of validated training.
Sensor-to-action controller BPTT, not an action-conditioned world-transition model.

implementation_surface_audit.implementation_status: No individual-effect HDC/CfC/LTC trainer exists in this pilot branch. Do not repurpose Broca intent-contrast training or HDC positive/negative contrastive_update. The next implementation must accumulate trajectory and all sibling-pair contrast gradients using shared pre-update parameters, then update once after all branches.
implementation_surface_audit.claim_boundary: Source inspection only. No training implementation, model run, or performance result is claimed.
